instruction: A candid portrait photograph in a medium close-up shot at eye-level, set indoors next to a window with a grey wall background. On the left, in the background, the woman in the white shirt (R1) stands behind, leaning her shoulder against the other woman's back and looking directly at the camera with a calm, soft expression. On the right, in the foreground, the woman in the grey long-sleeve shirt (R2) stands with her hands in her green trousers pockets, facing forward and looking directly at the camera with a subtle, gentle smile. The woman in the white shirt (R1) stands closely behind the woman in the grey shirt (R2), resting her right shoulder and arm against the back of the woman in the grey shirt's (R2) left shoulder. Bright, direct sunlight from the right casts sharp diagonal shadows across their shirts and faces, highlighting a neutral color palette of white, grey, and green.
elements: R1 stands closely behind R2 and leans her shoulder and arm against R2's back/left shoulder
R2 is the foreground person being leaned against by R1, rather than leaning on R1
R2 keeps her hands in her trouser pockets while R1 remains behind her in contact
both R1 and R2 face forward and look directly at the camera
the portrait is indoors next to a window with a grey wall background
bright direct sunlight casts sharp diagonal shadows across the two women
